audit.site: Trichy Fetal Medicine and Fertility Centre
audit.method: INDEXABLE=1 production build + next start on localhost:3101; raw-HTML fetch with bot user agents via Host header; source review; Lighthouse mobile lab
audit.note: fmctrichy.com still serves the old LiteSpeed site; this audit covers the new Next.js build

issues.title: Whole-site indexing silently depends on build-time env (VERCEL_ENV/INDEXABLE)
issues.evidence: app/layout.tsx:39-44 (robots meta), app/robots.ts:4-5 (rules), proxy.ts:10-20 (host gate). Verified: default local next start serves 'User-Agent: *\nDisallow: /' and meta robots noindex,nofollow on every page.
issues.fix: Add a deploy-time check asserting /robots.txt allows and a page emits index,follow on the production host; document INDEXABLE=1 for non-Vercel hosts in LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md.

issues.title: Consent-pending patient quotes hardcoded on home page bypass the consentOnFile gate
issues.evidence: components/home/why-choose-us.tsx:16,22 hardcodes quotes attributed to 'Manisha' and 'Deva'; data/testimonials.ts marks both consentOnFile: null (pending). Verified in production-mode HTML.
issues.fix: Drive proof-card quotes from data/testimonials.ts through the same consent gate, or remove the quotes until written consent is on file.

issues.title: No named author or medical reviewer rendered on any guide
issues.evidence: Byline renders only 'Written by the FMC Trichy clinical team' (unlinked) — app/guides/[slug]/page.tsx:263-265. reviewedBy unset on all guides — data/guides.ts comment; reviewer branch at page.tsx:104-107 never executes.
issues.fix: Set reviewedBy (and optionally an author field) to a doctor slug per guide after the doctors confirm review ownership; the byline, reviewer card and MedicalWebPage schema then activate automatically.

issues.title: Doctor profiles lack registration number, memberships, languages, experience year, detailed quals; no articles list
issues.evidence: data/doctors.ts: registration null, memberships [], languages [], experienceSinceYear null, qualificationsDetailed []; no 'articles by this doctor' section in app/doctors/[slug]/page.tsx. Dr Nivethitha has no profile (hasProfile:false) but appears in listings and clinic schema.
issues.fix: Fill typed-null fields from client data; add 'Articles reviewed by Dr X' section querying guides by reviewedBy; decide Nivethitha profile vs listing.

issues.title: No pillar/cluster architecture — flat guide list only
issues.evidence: 10 guides across 5 categories; category pages are card grids (app/guides/category/[slug]/page.tsx); no pillar content page exists; pregnancy-health category empty.
issues.fix: Promote category pages into real pillar content (intro sections + links to every cluster guide + related services) or create pillar guides; see cluster table in AUDIT_REPORT.md.

issues.title: Schema emitted as disconnected scripts; Article used instead of MedicalWebPage; about/author point to the clinic
issues.evidence: Separate JsonLd scripts per page (16 on home), no @graph, no WebSite node. app/guides/[slug]/page.tsx:146-156: Article with author=clinicRef, about=clinicRef; MedicalWebPage branch dead (no reviewedBy).
issues.fix: Single @graph per page: MedicalClinic#clinic, WebSite#website, WebPage/MedicalWebPage, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage linked by @id; about=MedicalCondition/MedicalProcedure node; author/reviewedBy=Person.

issues.title: Trust pages noindex + draft copy; Editorial Policy not footer-linked; no Medical Disclaimer page
issues.evidence: data/legal.ts draftPendingReview:true for all four; footer links only Privacy+Terms (components/site/site-footer.tsx:225-226); editorial-policy page renders 'This is a draft pending legal and client review'.
issues.fix: Complete counsel review, flip draftPendingReview flags, link Editorial Policy and a Medical Disclaimer page from the footer.

issues.title: Mobile LCP 3.7-4.6s in Lighthouse lab on all 4 page types
issues.evidence: lh-*.json: LCP home 4.6s, guide 4.3s, service 4.5s, doctor 3.7s; TBT 90-280ms; CLS 0; perf 81-84; ~23KB unused JS.
issues.fix: Re-measure on real CDN host; compress/resize hero image, verify sizes attr, reduce client JS on critical path.

issues.title: Printed QR links still point to drmalathi.vercel.app
issues.evidence: BOOKING_QR_ORIGIN = 'https://drmalathi.vercel.app'.
issues.fix: Switch base to https://fmctrichy.com and regenerate QR assets.

issues.title: Live domain still serves old LiteSpeed site; robots.txt 404s; http/https/www diverge
issues.evidence: curl: https apex 200 (40KB old template), www 200 (534KB different page), http 200 no redirect, /robots.txt LiteSpeed 404.
issues.fix: Deployment: cut DNS to the Next.js app, 301 http->https and www->apex, verify robots+sitemap on canonical host.

issues.title: Titles under 50 chars on most pages; ~8 meta descriptions outside 140-160
issues.evidence: Title/description length audit of all fetched pages.
issues.fix: Expand titles toward 'Primary keyword — qualifier | FMC Trichy'; re-range out-of-bounds descriptions in seoDescription fields.

issues.title: Service pages carry only 2-3 FAQs (target 4-8)
issues.evidence: data/services.ts faq arrays: fetal-echo 2, fetal-neurosonogram 2, second-opinion 2, first-trimester 3, growth 3, nipt 3, genetic-counselling 3, fetal-postmortem 3, recurrent-miscarriages 3, twin-clinic 3.
issues.fix: Add unique real-patient FAQs per service with 40-60-word direct answers.

issues.title: Guide FAQ answers below 40-60-word target; NIPT guide lacks quickAnswer
issues.evidence: Word-count audit of data/guides-blogs.ts.
issues.fix: Expand thin answers; add quickAnswer to the NIPT guide.

issues.title: 7 of 10 guides cite zero authoritative sources
issues.evidence: sources: present only on anomaly (5: ISUOG/SMFM/NHS), twin (2), nipt (2).
issues.fix: Add Sources sections citing ISUOG, SMFM, RCOG, FMF, WHO or guideline pages; verify each URL.

issues.title: 3 content images ship empty alt on the home page
issues.evidence: alt='' on viabilityscan.webp, NIPT.webp, AnomalyScan.webp in ServicesSection.
issues.fix: Descriptive alt text on the service-card images.

issues.title: og:url missing on every page; guides reuse webp cover as OG image
issues.evidence: No property='og:url' in any fetched page.
issues.fix: Emit openGraph.url = canonical; optionally generate opengraph-image for guides.

issues.title: Gestational week windows render while flagged draft-for-medical-review
issues.evidence: data/services.ts:75 SHOW_DRAFT_WEEK_WINDOWS = true.
issues.fix: Get medical sign-off or set false pre-launch.

issues.title: No INR cost, insurance or quoted statistics anywhere
issues.evidence: Zero currency mentions in rendered pages; NIPT guide has 'why prices differ' section without figures.
issues.fix: If client allows, add indicative INR ranges with disclaimers; biggest single GEO win.

issues.title: MedicalProcedure applied to clinic-type services
issues.evidence: lib/schema.ts:178-191 single type for every service.
issues.fix: Use MedicalTherapy/Service typing for clinic services.

issues.title: Category pages are thin (heading + one-line description + card grid)
issues.evidence: app/guides/category/[slug]/page.tsx.
issues.fix: Add 200-400 words of pillar copy + service links per category.

issues.title: Brand says 'Fertility Centre' but no fertility service exists; fertility guides have no relatedService
